{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsCXZwArq4pjDi8MYsKk","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017e6MZjaViJapQSASpB2g4Z","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 <<'EOF'\nimport csv, re\n\npeople = list(csv.DictReader(open(\"dataset/people_accounts.csv\", encoding=\"utf-8\")))\nprint(\"last names with spaces:\", [p['last_name'] for p in people if ' ' in p['last_name']][:5])\nprint(\"first names with spaces:\", sorted({p['first_name'] for p in people if ' ' in p['first_name']}))\n\nlines = open(\"dataset/genealogy_trees.txt\", encoding=\"utf-8\").read().split(\"\\n\")\nWORD = re.compile(r\"[^\\W\\d_]+\", re.UNICODE)\ntokens = {}  # row -> list of (word, c0, c1)\nallwords = 0\nfor r, l in enumerate(lines):\n    toks = [(m.group(0), m.start(), m.end()) for m in WORD.finditer(l)]\n    toks = [t for t in toks if not (r < 5 or r > 110)]  # skip header/footer\n    if toks:\n        tokens[r] = toks\n        allwords += len(toks)\nprint(\"total words in grid:\", allwords)\n\ndef find_seq(row, words):\n    \"\"\"find consecutive token runs on row matching words; return list of (c0,c1)\"\"\"\n    res = []\n    toks = tokens.get(row, [])\n    for i in range(len(toks) - len(words) + 1):\n        if all(toks[i+j][0] == words[j] for j in range(len(words))):\n            res.append((toks[i][1], toks[i+len(words)-1][2]))\n    return res\n\nmatches = {}  # fullname -> list of (r0, r1, c0, c1)\nfor p in people:\n    fn, ln = p['first_name'].split(), p['last_name'].split()\n    name = f\"{p['first_name']} {p['last_name']}\"\n    locs = []\n    for r in tokens:\n        # single line\n        for (c0, c1) in find_seq(r, fn + ln):\n            locs.append((r, r, c0, c1))\n        # wrapped: fn on row r, ln on row r+1\n        for (fc0, fc1) in find_seq(r, fn):\n            for (lc0, lc1) in find_seq(r + 1, ln):\n                if lc0 < fc1 + 15 and lc1 > fc0 - 15:  # roughly aligned\n                    locs.append((r, r + 1, min(fc0, lc0), max(fc1, lc1)))\n    if locs:\n        matches[name] = locs\n\nmulti = {n: l for n, l in matches.items() if len(l) > 1}\nprint(\"people matched:\", len(matches), \"of\", len(people))\nprint(\"multi-location names:\", len(multi))\nfor n, l in list(multi.items())[:10]:\n    print(\"  \", n, l)\nEOF","description":"Match CSV names against grid positions"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5575,"cache_read_input_tokens":28500,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":5575,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"5ab4d659-d0f4-40e8-acba-dd76e089ac66","uuid":"9161160e-5ab4-40ec-a838-5c9573a189a7","request_id":"req_011CcsCXZ9nqWN67aTLpC64D"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsCabo7whwGaNo9ckZ37","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0132XbgHeP3GryS4UUNPXmRX","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/parse.py <<'EOF'\nimport csv, re\n\npeople = list(csv.DictReader(open(\"/app/dataset/people_accounts.csv\", encoding=\"utf-8\")))\nbalance = {f\"{p['first_name']} {p['last_name']}\": int(p['account_balance']) for p in people}\nlines = open(\"/app/dataset/genealogy_trees.txt\", encoding=\"utf-8\").read().split(\"\\n\")\nW = max(len(l) for l in lines)\ngrid = [l.ljust(W) for l in lines]\n\nWORD = re.compile(r\"[^\\W\\d_]+\", re.UNICODE)\ntokens = {}\nfor r, l in enumerate(lines):\n    if r < 5 or r > 110: continue\n    toks = [(m.group(0), m.start(), m.end()) for m in WORD.finditer(l)]\n    if toks: tokens[r] = toks\n\ndef find_seq(row, words):\n    res = []\n    toks = tokens.get(row, [])\n    for i in range(len(toks) - fc0) <= 2:\n                    locs.append((r, r+1, min(fc0,lc0), max(fc1,lc1), [(r,fi0,fi1),(r+1,li0,li1)]))\n    if len(locs) > 1:\n        print(\"AMBIG:\", name, [(l[0],l[2]) for l in locs])\n    if locs:\n        r0, r1, c0, c1, tk = locs[0]\n        boxes[name] = (r0, r1, c0, c1)\n        for (row, i0, i1) in tk: claim(name, row, i0, i1)\n\nnwords = sum(len(t) for t in tokens.values())\nprint(\"boxes:\", len(boxes), \"| words:\", nwords, \"| words claimed:\", len(used))\n# report unclaimed words\nfor r, toks in tokens.items():\n    for i, t in enumerate(toks):\n        if (r, i) not in used:\n            print(\"UNCLAIMED:\", r+1, t)\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/parse.py","description":"Detect all name boxes with strict alignment and verify word coverage"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":694,"cache_read_input_tokens":35969,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":694,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"5ab4d659-d0f4-40e8-acba-dd76e089ac66","uuid":"a5b48def-b0df-423d-a6b8-15910fa1025b","request_id":"req_011CcsCaamrfyE8VViDN9L3f"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsCd4P5wu4M6H9SXXaDE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013b47NjG1hRYMLLDvnghkrr","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/boxes.py <<'EOF'\nimport csv, re\n\npeople = list(csv.DictReader(open(\"/app/dataset/people_accounts.csv\", encoding=\"utf-8\")))\nlines = open(\"/app/dataset/genealogy_trees.txt\", encoding=\"utf-8\").read().split(\"\\n\")\nW = max(len(l) for l in lines)\ngrid = [l.ljust(W) for l in lines]\n\nWORD = re.compile(r\"[^\\W\\d_]+\", re.UNICODE)\ntokens = {}\nfor r, l in enumerate(lines):\n    if r < 5 or r > 110: continue\n    toks = [(m.group(0), m.start(), m.end()) for m in WORD.finditer(l)]\n    if toks: tokens[r] = toks\n\ndef find_seq(row, words):\n    res = []\n    toks = tokens.get(row, [])\n    for i in range(len(toks) - len(words) + 1):\n        if all(toks[i+j][0] == words[j] for j in range(len(words))):\n            res.append((toks[i][1], toks[i+len(words)-1][2]))\n    return res\n\nboxes = {}\nfor p in people:\n    fn, ln = p['first_name'].split(), p['last_name'].split()\n    name = f\"{p['first_name']} {p['last_name']}\"\n    locs = []\n    for r in tokens:\n        for (c0, c1) in find_seq(r, fn + ln):\n            locs.append((r, r, c0, c1))\n        for (fc0, fc1) in find_seq(r, fn):\n            for (lc0, lc1) in find_seq(r + 1, ln):\n                if abs(lc0 - fc0) <= 2:\n                    locs.append((r, r+1, min(fc0,lc0), max(fc1,lc1)))\n    if locs:\n        boxes[name] = locs[0]\n\nimport json\njson.dump({k: list(v) for k, v in boxes.items()}, open(\"/tmp/boxes.json\",\"w\"))\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import random\n    random.seed(4)\n    for name in random.sample(list(boxes), 8):\n        r0, r1, c0, c1 = boxes[name]\n        print(f\"=== {name} rows {r0}-{r1} cols {c0}-{c1}\")\n        for r in range(max(0,r0-4), r1+5):\n            print(f\"{r:4d}|{grid[r][max(0,c0-8):c1+9]}\")\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/boxes.py","description":"Save box locations and sample box neighborhoods"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":425,"cache_read_input_tokens":38665,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":425,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"5ab4d659-d0f4-40e8-acba-dd76e089ac66","uuid":"3364949d-57ea-4bde-9063-fe8b58f26fbe","request_id":"req_011CcsCd3UmETQ7sAVwoeMz1"}

5 <= c <= c1 + 5): continue\n        if direction == \"down\" and r0 - 3 <= r <= r1: return name\n        if direction == \"up\" and r0 <= r <= r1 + 3: return name\n    return None\n\ndef follow(r, c, dr, self_name):\n    \"\"\"follow a stem from (r,c) in direction dr (+1 down, -1 up).\n    returns ('box', name) or ('conn', r, c) or ('dead', r, c)\"\"\"\n    steps = 0\n    while steps < 40:\n        steps += 1\n        b = box_at(r, c, \"down\" if dr > 0 else \"up\")\n        if b and b != self_name:\n            return ('box', b)\n        # connector row test: current char is on a row with horiz run\n        if at(r, c) in HORIZ or is_horiz_row(r, c) >= 3:\n            if is_horiz_row(r, c) >= 2:\n                return ('conn', r, c)\n        # advance\n        moved = False\n        for rgap in (1, 2, 3):\n            for dc in (0, -1, 1, -2, 2):\n                ch = at(r + dr * rgap, c + dc)\n                if ch in VERT:\n                    r, c = r + dr * rgap, c + dc\n                    moved = True\n                    break\n            if moved: break\n            # maybe connector row is at r+dr*rgap but junction char degraded\n            if is_horiz_row(r + dr * rgap, c, exclude_self=False) >= 3:\n                return ('conn', r + dr * rgap, c)\n        if not moved:\n            return ('dead', r, c)\n    return ('dead', r, c)\n\ndef stem_start(name, dr):\n    \"\"\"find the stem cell just outside the box in direction dr\"\"\"\n    r0, r1, c0, c1 = boxes[name]\n    rows = range(r1 + 1, r1 + 6) if dr > 0 else range(r0 - 1, r0 - 6, -1)\n    for r in rows:\n        # skip rows that look like box border: many horiz chars within text span\n        span = [at(r, c) for c in range(c0 - 2, c1 + 3)]\n        nh = sum(1 for ch in span if ch in HORIZ)\n        cands = [c for c in range(c0, c1 + 1) if at(r, c) in VERT and at(r,c) != '+']\n        if nh >= 3:\n            continue  # border row\n        # exclude side-border verticals (at or outside text edges +/-2)\n        cands = [c for c in cands if c0 + 1 <= c <= c1 - 1]\n        if cands:\n            mid = (c0 + c1) / 2\n            return r, min(cands, key=lambda c: abs(c - mid))\n    return None\n\ndef walk_connector(r, jc):\n    \"\"\"walk connector row r from junction jc; return (cols_with_down_stem, cols_with_up_stem)\"\"\"\n    cols = set()\n    for direction in (-1, 1):\n        c = jc\n        gap = 0\n        while 0 <= c < W:\n            ch = at(r, c)\n            if ch in HORIZ:\n                cols.add(c); gap = 0\n            elif ch == ' ':\n                gap += 1\n                if gap > 3: break\n            else:\n                break\n            c += direction\n    cols.add(jc)\n    down, up = [], []\n    for c in sorted(cols):\n        for rg in (1, 2):\n            if any(at(r + rg, c + dc) in (VERT - {'+','x'}) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)):\n                down.append(c); break\n        for rg in (1, 2):\n            if any(at(r - rg, c + dc) in (VERT - {'+','x'}) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)):\n                up.append(c); break\n    return down, up\n\ndef dedupe_adjacent(cols):\n    out = []\n    for c in cols:\n        if out and c - out[-1] <= 2: continue\n        out.append(c)\n    return out\n\ndef children_of(name):\n    ss = stem_start(name, +1)\n    if not ss: return []\n    res = follow(ss[0], ss[1], +1, name)\n    if res[0] == 'box':  # direct connection? unusual\n        return [res[1]]\n    if res[0] != 'conn': return []\n    _, r, jc = res\n    down, _ = walk_connector(r, jc)\n    kids = []\n    for c in dedupe_adjacent(down):\n        # find stem cell below\n        for rg in (1, 2):\n            hit = [(r + rg, c + dc) for dc in (0, -1, 1) if at(r + rg, c + dc) in (VERT - {'+','x'})]\n            if hit:\n                res2 = follow(hit[0][0], hit[0][1], +1, name)\n                if res2[0] == 'box': kids.append(res2[1])\n                else: kids.append(('?', res2))\n                break\n    return kids\n\ndef parent_of(name):\n    ss = stem_start(name, -1)\n    if not ss: return None\n    res = follow(ss[0], ss[1], -1, name)\n    if res[0] == 'box':\n        return res[1]\n    if res[0] != 'conn': return ('?', res)\n    _, r, jc = res\n    _, up = walk_connector(r, jc)\n    ups = dedupe_adjacent(up)\n    results = []\n    for c in ups:\n        for rg in (1, 2):\n            hit = [(r - rg, c + dc) for dc in (0, -1, 1) if at(r - rg, c + dc) in (VERT - {'+','x'})]\n            if hit:\n                res2 = follow(hit[0][0], hit[0][1], -1, name)\n                results.append(res2)\n                break\n    bx = [x[1] for x in results if x[0] == 'box']\n    if len(bx) == 1: return bx[0]\n    return ('?', results)\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    # trace the ancestor chain of Dawid Majtyka\n    cur = \"Dawid Majtyka\"\n    chain = [cur]\n    for _ in range(4):\n        p = parent_of(cur)\n        print(f\"parent of {cur}: {p}\")\n        if not isinstance(p, str): break\n        chain.append(p); cur = p\n    print(\"chain:\", chain)\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/tree.py","description":"Build wire tracer and trace ancestor chain up from Dawid Majtyka"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6045,"cache_read_input_tokens":39090,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":6045,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"5ab4d659-d0f4-40e8-acba-dd76e089ac66","uuid":"a20f8aca-78ad-4f12-9bd0-bbecb8b286f0","request_id":"req_011CcsCjG9vLcbCMR2dnt116"}
